pre-commit.description: Keep the hook revisions in .pre-commit-config.yaml current (the manager is opt-in)

packageRules.description: Hold the Semgrep job's Python below 3.15: semgrep supports Python up to 3.14, and on 3.15 its engine segfaults (semgrep-core exits -11), which fails the Semgrep check. Lift this once semgrep supports 3.15
